name: Classic Balanced Bowl
description: Designed for everyday wellness and sustained energy. A nourishing mix of brown rice, herb chickpeas, fresh vegetables and roasted peanuts.
shortDescription: Brown rice, herb chickpeas, cucumber, carrot, corn, roasted peanuts

name: Max Protein Bowl
description: Our highest-protein bowl. 40g of protein from paneer, edamame and sprouts to support recovery, strength and satiety. Finished with sunflower seeds and a bold black pepper, smoked paprika, chaat masala seasoning.
shortDescription: Millet, quinoa, mixed sprouts, broccoli, bell pepper, beetroot microgreens

components.ingredient: Black Pepper + Smoked Paprika + Chaat Masala

name: Premium Harvest Bowl
description: Crafted for those who enjoy gourmet flavours without compromising nutrition. Quinoa with low fat paneer, peppery arugula, roasted zucchini, cherry tomatoes, and white radish microgreens.
shortDescription: Quinoa, grilled paneer, arugula, roasted zucchini, cherry tomato, almonds

name: Spicy Piña Bowl
description: Bold, sweet, and fiery. Fresh pineapple with sliced jalapeños and paprika. Inspired by Mexican street-style fruit cups. Pair with Honey Lime Classic or Chaat Masala dressing.
shortDescription: Pineapple, jalapeño, paprika — Mexican-style spicy fruit

name: Summer Circle Bowl
description: Cut in beautiful rounds for visual impact and easy eating. Watermelon, muskmelon, and dragon fruit layered with black grapes and fresh mint. Pair with Coconut Cream or Honey Lime.
shortDescription: Watermelon, muskmelon, dragon fruit circles, grapes, mint

name: Apple Loaded Fries
description: Sliced red apple and green apple with a cinnamon spice sachet. Light, autumnal, and comforting. Pair with our Maple Syrup or Ginger Honey Zest dressing.
shortDescription: Red apple, green apple, cinnamon spice sachet
suggestedDressing: Maple Syrup or Ginger Honey Zest

name: Ginger Turmeric Shot
description: 50ml concentrated immunity shot. Fresh ginger, turmeric, black pepper, lemon. Black pepper activates curcumin absorption by up to 2000%. Take daily.
shortDescription: Ginger, turmeric, black pepper, lemon

name: Lemon Ginger Shot
description: 50ml bright and sharp. Fresh lemon juice, raw ginger, black salt. A natural digestive kickstarter and Vitamin C hit. Best taken first thing in the morning.
shortDescription: Lemon, ginger, black salt — digestive kickstarter

name: Tulsi Ginger Shot
description: 50ml sacred Indian adaptogen. Holy basil (tulsi) with raw ginger and raw honey. Stress-relieving, respiratory support, adaptogenic.
shortDescription: Holy basil, ginger, raw honey — adaptogenic Ayurvedic shot

name: Amla Shot
description: 50ml Indian gooseberry — one of the richest natural sources of Vitamin C on the planet. Supports hair, skin collagen, and immune function.
shortDescription: Indian gooseberry — 20× the Vitamin C of an orange

name: Wheatgrass Shot
description: 50ml pure wheatgrass juice. Chlorophyll-dense, alkalising, deeply detoxifying. Best taken on an empty stomach.
shortDescription: Pure wheatgrass — chlorophyll-rich and alkalising

name: Aloe Vera Shot
description: 50ml organic aloe vera juice. Cooling, soothing, gut-calming. Reduces acid reflux and supports skin hydration. A gentle daily ritual.
shortDescription: Organic aloe vera — gut-soothing and skin-hydrating

name: Coconut Water
description: ~450ml natural tender coconut water. No added sugar, no preservatives. The original electrolyte drink — potassium-rich and naturally isotonic.
shortDescription: Pure tender coconut, natural electrolytes

name: Kombucha
description: ~450ml live-culture fermented tea. Probiotic-rich, lightly effervescent, ginger-lime flavour. Supports gut microbiome, liver function, and digestion.
shortDescription: Probiotic fermented tea — gut health in a bottle

name: Protein Smoothie
description: ~450ml plant-based protein smoothie. Banana, oat milk, almond butter, and plant protein powder. Thick, filling, genuinely post-workout ready.
shortDescription: Plant protein, banana, oat milk, almond butter

name: Makhana
description: Roasted fox nuts (lotus seeds) with Himalayan pink salt. Light, airy, addictive — and genuinely nutritious. Ancient Indian superfood.
shortDescription: Roasted lotus seeds, Himalayan pink salt

name: Trail Mix
description: Almonds, cashews, walnuts, raisins, goji berries, dark chocolate chips. The perfect desk snack.
shortDescription: Almonds, cashews, walnuts, goji, dark chocolate

name: Roasted Chickpeas
description: Crunchy oven-roasted chickpeas in masala or classic salted. High in fibre and plant protein.
shortDescription: Roasted chickpeas — masala or classic salted

name: Seed Mix
description: Pumpkin, sunflower, flax, and chia seeds. A dense Omega-3 and mineral blend. Eat straight or sprinkle on your bowl.
shortDescription: Pumpkin, sunflower, flax, chia — Omega-3 blend

name: Peri Peri Yogurt Dressing
description: Creamy Greek-style yogurt with peri peri spice, lemon, and garlic. Fiery, tangy, and cooling. Pairs best with Classic Balanced Bowl and Max Protein Bowl.
shortDescription: Greek yogurt, peri peri, lemon, garlic

name: Classic Lemon Vinaigrette
description: Cold-pressed olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, garlic, sea salt. Clean and timeless. Goes with everything.
shortDescription: Olive oil, lemon, Dijon mustard, garlic

name: Tahini Garlic Dressing
description: Sesame tahini, roasted garlic, lemon, cumin. Rich, nutty, deeply satisfying. Best with Zoodle Bowl and Max Protein Bowl.
shortDescription: Sesame tahini, roasted garlic, lemon, cumin

name: Garlic Parmesan Dressing
description: Roasted garlic, Parmesan, Greek yogurt, lemon, cracked black pepper. Creamy and bold. The hero pairing for Premium Harvest Bowl.
shortDescription: Roasted garlic, Parmesan, Greek yogurt, lemon

name: Green Goddess Dressing
description: Blended coriander, mint, basil, olive oil, green chilli, garlic, lemon. Vibrant and fresh. Works beautifully with any bowl.
shortDescription: Coriander, mint, basil, olive oil, green chilli, lemon

name: Honey Lime Classic
description: Raw honey, fresh lime juice, black salt. Light, sweet, citrusy. Lets the fruit shine without overpowering it.
shortDescription: Raw honey, fresh lime, black salt

name: Chaat Masala + Lemon
description: Traditional chaat masala — amchur, cumin, black pepper, asafoetida — with fresh lemon juice. The most Indian dressing on our menu. Transforms any fruit box.
shortDescription: Chaat masala, lemon, black pepper — bold Indian flavour

name: Coconut Cream
description: Lightly sweetened coconut cream with a hint of vanilla. Thick, tropical, indulgent. Best with Summer Circle Box or Apple Harvest Box.
shortDescription: Coconut cream, touch of vanilla

name: Maple Syrup
description: Pure Grade A maple syrup. Low GI compared to refined sugar, with trace minerals. Perfect pour-on for Apple Harvest Box.
shortDescription: Pure Grade A maple syrup — low GI natural sweetener

name: Ginger Honey Zest
description: Raw honey, freshly grated ginger, lemon zest, cardamom. Warming and aromatic. Especially good with apple or tropical fruit.
shortDescription: Raw honey, fresh ginger, lemon zest, cardamom

name: Rainbow Zoodle Bowl
description: Spiralised carrot and two-tone zucchini noodles with sesame seeds, tossed in our Asian Soy-Sesame dressing — included in the box. Raw, light, and refreshing. A complete meal as-is, or add a protein bowl for extra fuel.
shortDescription: Spiralised carrot, green & yellow zucchini, sesame seeds — Asian soy-sesame dressing included
dressingDescription: Tamari soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, rice vinegar, fresh ginger, garlic, and a touch of honey. Umami-rich and deeply satisfying.
note: Dressing is bundled in the box — no separate purchase needed. Asian soy-sesame is specifically designed for this bowl.

name: Lentil Vegetable Broth Soup
description: A deeply nourishing vegetable broth cooked with red lentils, spinach, and a warming spice blend — turmeric, cumin, coriander, and black pepper. Anti-inflammatory, gut-friendly, and genuinely filling. Served in a sealed cup, heat-ready in 90 seconds.
shortDescription: Red lentil broth, spinach, carrot, turmeric, cumin, coriander
note: Served cold — microwave 90 seconds or consume at room temperature. Best paired with a wellness shot.

name: Overnight Oats
description: Rolled oats soaked overnight in oat milk, topped with chia seeds and your choice of seasonal toppings. Two flavour variants: Classic Vanilla Bean and Cocoa Banana. Slow-release energy that keeps you full until lunch.
shortDescription: Overnight rolled oats, oat milk, chia seeds, seasonal toppings

toppings: PLACEHOLDER — rotate weekly based on seasonal fruit availability

name: Veg Sushi Rolls
description: PLACEHOLDER — Recipe and presentation to be confirmed with kitchen team. Proposed: 6-piece nori rolls with sushi rice, avocado, cucumber, carrot, and pickled ginger. Served with a soy-sesame dipping sachet.
shortDescription: 6-piece nori rolls — avocado, cucumber, carrot, pickled ginger
